# ADRIANA
# VALENCIA
# AC TRANSIT • WARD 3
# ALAMEDA • OAKLAND • PIEDMONT
# A Rider's Voice for Reliable Transit.
PHOTO BY MAURICE RAMIREZ
JOIN ME
“I’m running to be your representative for AC Transit because I believe that transit should be reliable, affordable, and that government agencies should be transparent.”
## SUPPORT ADRIANA’S CAMPAIGN
IT IS CRITICAL TO GET MESSAGING OUT TO VOTERS AND YOUR DONATION WILL HELP WITH DOORHANGERS, POSTCARDS, ADVERTISING, & YARD SIGNS .
$25
$100
$50
$250
$500
## I’m a transit rider, a product manager, and a mom.
The oldest child of Colombian immigrants to New Jersey, I grew up riding NJ Transit and the New York City MTA. I’ve now spent more than half my life calling the East Bay home.
I’m a pedestrian, cyclist, and transit rider who believes that robust transit makes cities better. Car ownership should be a choice, not a requirement for being an independent adult in a viable urban area.
I’ve spent my career building digital products for global users, navigating high-complexity organizations and building adaptable, scalable solutions. I believe that I can bring those skills to AC Transit.
As a mom, I want my child to learn independence, and a dependable and safe bus transit system is a critical component of that independence. If we make AC Transit usable for our kids, we will create a better future for the Bay Area.
# ENDORSEMENT: SARAH SYED
CURRENT AC TRANSIT DIRECTOR • WARD 3
"At a critical moment for public transit, we need leaders who fight for riders. Adriana Valencia is a frequent rider, a committed advocate, and exactly the practical leader AC Transit needs on its Board."
